name: dcms-form-packages
description: Source repository for the DCMS custom packages @dcms/form-rules and @dcms/form-rules-react.

scripts.build:engine: npm run build --workspace=@dcms/form-rules && npm run build:examples --workspace=@dcms/form-rules
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:react
scripts.pack: npm run pack:engine && npm run pack:react && npm run hash
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm test && npm run pack
